column1: #origin.hypothesis=Docker lifecycle materially contributes to repeated veth uevent bursts, but retained tapes do not bind a container endpoint to its ephemeral host veth or mesh task
#origin.question=can a read-only mesh observer retain a source-side container-endpoint-to-host-veth join alongside the seqnum window?

#origin.acceptance=implement a bounded observer and durable artifact that records event time, container ID, endpoint/peer ifindex, host veth DEVPATH, available launching mesh task key, and nearby seqnum baseline/delta; represent unavailable joins explicitly and verify the real read path plus fixture mapping
#origin.feedback=use the retained tuple on the next comparable burst; do not infer identity from temporal proximity or change substrate configuration

column3: On mesh-home, design and implement a read-only bounded observer for Docker virtual-network lifecycle that records event time, container ID, network endpoint/peer ifindex, host-side veth DEVPATH, launching mesh task key when available, and nearby uevent_seqnum baseline/delta. Retain explicit unknowns when a join cannot be made. Verify the real read path and a fixture with a known endpoint-to-host-veth mapping. Do not change routing, networking, container, USB, or service configuration as part of capture.
